messages:
nina: Quick sync 1 retention tiers + legal-hold process for SIEM exports. Need signoff on defaults.
ashok: outline the tiers? short bullets ok.
elaine: TL;DR: we want short-term fast access, medium-term searchable, long-term locked archive. plus legal-hold override.
nina: Proposed defaults: 
- Tier A (hot): 30d searchable (ELK/SIEM), full fidelity, accessible to SecOps/Triage roles.
- Tier B (warm): 180d indexed, partial PII redaction, expensive queries via request.
- Tier C (cold archive): 7y encrypted snapshots, CMK-wrapped, read-only via forensics request.
security-bot: Policy draft: https://redwood.internal/policies/retention-tiers-v1 (uploaded)
ashok: How do we implement legal-hold? need immutable flag so retention countdown pauses. Also must keep audit trail of holds/unholds.
elaine: Legal-hold flow: Legal ops creates hold via ticket -> retention-admin role toggles hold on dataset -> system stamps hold_id + requester + timestamp; lifecycle policies ignore held objects.
legal-ops: Confirming: holds can be applied cross-region? we need to ensure copies in DR are also held.
nina: Yes, hold propagates to replicas. Technical note: hold metadata stored in metadata-store (readonly to services) and enforced at lifecycle worker.
oncall-oliver: Oncall concern: if we keep held data immutable forever it could block storage reclamation. Need retention review cadence and TTL on holds (renewable).
elaine: Agreed. Recommend initial hold length 1y auto-expire unless legal renews. Add weekly hold report to legal ops and finance for cost visibility.
ashok: KMS details: archives should be CMK-wrapped keys with HSM. For cross-tenant exports, use separate key hierarchy per tenant. Key policy must restrict unwrap to retention-exec role + proxy. No direct service account access.
nina: For SIEM exports (ad-hoc snapshots): default snapshot TTL 90d, stored in cold archive if requested longer. Snapshots marked with export_ticket_id and approver.
nina: Example S3 lifecycle rule snippet for cold-ingest: 
``` 
Rule: move-to-cold
Match: prefix: snapshots/{ticket_id}/
Transition: after 7d -> GLACIER
Expiration: 2555d (7y)
```
elaine: Deletion policy: deletions must be async and logged. deletion_event: {actor, ticket_id, dataset, object_keys, timestamp, cmk_key_id}. Keep deletion audit logs for 2y.
security-bot: Compliance checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/compliance/retention-checklist-v2
ashok: RBAC roles draft: retention-requester, retention-approver, retention-admin, retention-auditor. retention-admin can toggle holds and manage lifecycle rules. retention-approver approves extended retention/export. retention-auditor has read-only view of audit logs.
elaine: For external vendor access: never allow raw hot-tier access. Only anonymized aggregates or synthetic datasets. If an exec signs off, snapshot must be double-encrypted (tenant CMK + vendor-wrapped key) and have extremely short TTL.
nina: Subpoena/legal request handling: legal-ops to provide signed subpoena ticket; retention-admin to apply hold and create export. All steps recorded. If law requires deletion despite hold, escalate to exec + legal and record rationale.
oncall-oliver: Runbook item: if lifecycle worker errors when applying hold -> alert to oncall and create a blocking incident. Do not proceed with deletions until resolved.
ashok: Automation asks: 1) auto-detect stale holds (no activity > 180d) and notify legal. 2) daily audit report to security/audit team.
nina: Data minimization: implement automated PII scrub for warm tier. scrub pipeline should run before moving data to warm. Need list of PII fields and regexes.
elaine: Can we use differential retention? e.g., auth logs 180d, payment logs 365d due to compliance. We'll need per-dataset overrides.
nina: Yes, per-dataset policy override allowed with approver role. default dataset map will live in config-service.
legal-ops: Request: add explicit chain-of-custody entries when exporting for court. Must include signer identity, export hash, and storage location.
ashok: Technical note: to support chain-of-custody, compute SHA256 of snapshot before and after transfer; store hashes in audit log signed by CMK.
nina: Action items: - nina: update policy doc with tiers + hold TTLs + ticket templates. - ashok: publish RBAC role defs and IAM statements. - elaine: draft PII regex list and scrub pipeline spec. - oncall-oliver: add lifecycle worker error runbook. - legal-ops: confirm hold renewal cadence and subpoena handling steps.
elaine: sample ticket template for hold:
```
Title: Legal Hold Request - CASE-2026-77
Dataset: auth-traces
Scope: 2026-02-01..2026-03-01
Requested hold TTL: 365d (renewable)
Reason: subpoena - Case 2026-77
Requester: legal-ops
Approver: legal-lead
```
nina: thx all. I'll post v1.1 later today and tag folks for review. :rocket:
